title: Reconstruction of a parsed pair
statement: Let $z$ be a bit string for which the aligned pair parser succeeds, and let $\pi_1(z)$ and $\pi_2(z)$ be its decoded components. Then $z=\langle\pi_1(z),\pi_2(z)\rangle$, where the pairing doubles each bit of the first component, appends the separator $01$, and then appends the second component.
replaced: Let $z$ be a bit string that parses as a self-delimiting pair encoding, and let $\pi_1(z)$ and $\pi_2(z)$ be its decoded first and second components. Then $z = \langle \pi_1(z), \pi_2(z)\rangle$.
